# Simplified Technical English rewrite

Rewrite the text in Simplified Technical English. Use simple words and short sentences.

test_case_results.source_text: You can't run the integration tests without Docker, since each test starts its own containers for the DB and the message queue, and the containers are removed automatically after the test finishes, whether it passes or fails.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: You cannot run the integration tests without Docker. Each test starts its own containers for the database and message queue. The containers are removed automatically when the test passes or fails.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the Docker requirement, separate containers for the database and message queue, and automatic removal after either a passing or failing test.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite speaks to the reader 1 times, with: You

test_case_results.source_text: To reduce the size of the bundle, the build tool removes any code that isn't used by the app, but this only works if the libs you import are published as ES modules, so prefer those libs over the ones that only ship CommonJS.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: To reduce the bundle size, the build tool removes code that the app does not use. This works only when the libraries that you import are published as ES modules. Therefore, prefer these libraries over libraries that are available only as CommonJS modules.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite keeps the bundle-size goal, the condition that unused code is removed only for imported libraries published as ES modules, and the instruction to prefer those libraries over ones available only as CommonJS modules.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite uses abbreviations: ES, app
the rewrite speaks to the reader 1 times, with: you

test_case_results.source_text: The feature flag service lets you enable a new feature for a subset of users, e.g. only for internal staff, and it's strongly recommended to leave a flag on for at least a week before you remove it, in order to be able to switch the feature off quickly if something goes wrong.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: The feature flag service lets you enable a new feature for a group of users. For example, you can enable the feature only for internal staff. Keep the flag on for at least one week before you remove it. This lets you switch off the feature quickly if a problem occurs.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves the user subset, internal staff example, strong recommendation to keep the flag for at least one week, and the quick switch-off condition if a problem occurs.

rule_checks.failure_reason: the rewrite speaks to the reader 4 times, with: you

test_case_results.source_text: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt before they're stored in the DB, and the app never logs them or sends them to any third-party service, so even an admin who has full access to the DB can't read a user's password.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: The application hashes passwords with bcrypt before it stores them in the database. The application does not log passwords or send them to third-party services. Therefore, an administrator with full database access cannot read a user's password.

meaning_judgment.reason: The rewrite preserves all facts and conditions from the source without adding any new information.

test_case_results.source_text: If the deploy job hangs for more than 15 min, cancel it from the CI dashboard, check the status page of our cloud provider for any ongoing incident, and only then start the job again, because a second deploy that runs in parallel with the first might leave the servers in an inconsistent state.
test_case_results.rewritten_text: If the deploy job runs for more than 15 minutes, cancel it in the continuous integration dashboard. Check the cloud provider's status page for an active incident. Start the job again only after these checks. A second deploy job that runs at the same time can leave the servers in an inconsistent state.

meaning_judgment.reason: The source says to act only when the deploy job hangs, while the rewrite applies the instruction to any job that runs for more than 15 minutes.

rule_checks.failure_reason: The source says to act only when the deploy job hangs, while the rewrite applies the instruction to any job that runs for more than 15 minutes.
